items.exampleEn: Tonight it's my turn to make dinner.
Run! We don't want to miss the bus.
items.exampleZh: 快跑！我們可不想錯過公車。

items.exampleEn: These jackets are on sale this week.
items.exampleZh: 這些外套這星期在特價。

items.exampleEn: We waited in line for an hour to buy tickets.
items.exampleZh: 我們排隊排了一個小時買票。

items.sentenceEn: Many people are waiting in line outside the new shop.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人在新開的店外面排隊。

items.audioEn: We talked too long at the station, so we missed the bus.
items.audioZh: 我們在車站聊太久，所以錯過了公車。
items.questionZh: 說話的人和同伴怎麼了？
options: They got lost on the way to the station
They forgot to bring their bus cards

items.sentenceEn: The kids next door make noise all day.
items.sentenceZh: 隔壁的小孩整天吵吵鬧鬧。

items.sentenceEn: My mom is making dinner in the kitchen.
items.sentenceZh: 我媽媽正在廚房做晚餐。

items.stemEn: I left home five minutes late and ____, so I took a taxi.
items.stemZh: 我晚了五分鐘出門，錯過了公車，所以我搭了計程車。

items.stemEn: This shirt is ____ today. It's only two hundred dollars.
items.stemZh: 這件襯衫今天特價，只要兩百元。

items.passageEn: Every Friday evening, my aunt goes to the supermarket near her home. The food there is often on sale on Fridays, so many people wait in line to pay. Last Friday, the line was so long that she almost missed the bus home. Luckily, the bus didn't come on time. It was ten minutes late! When she got home, she made dinner for the whole family.
items.passageZh: 每個星期五傍晚，我阿姨都會去她家附近的超市。那裡的食物星期五常常特價，所以很多人排隊結帳。上星期五，隊伍長到她差點錯過回家的公車。還好公車沒有準時來，晚了十分鐘！她回到家後，為全家人做了晚餐。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼星期五很多人排隊？
阿姨後來為什麼沒錯過公車？

items.promptZh: 我爸爸每天都準時上班。
referenceEn: My dad gets to work on time every day.
My father is on time for work every day.
Every day, my dad goes to work on time.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 on time 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 is never late for work 等）也算對
每天的習慣用現在簡單式（例如 gets to work、goes to work、is on time 等）

items.promptZh: 請不要在這裡製造噪音，寶寶正在睡覺。
referenceEn: Please don't make noise here. The baby is sleeping.
The baby is sleeping, so please don't make noise here.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 make noise、make any noise 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 be noisy、be quiet 等）也算對
「正在睡覺」可寫，例如 is sleeping、is asleep 等
兩句的先後順序不限，也可以用 so 連接
